mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: MacOS 10.15+
  • Processor: Apple Silicon or Intel (x86_64 or ARM CPU)
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics with full Vulkan 1.0 support or Metal 3 support
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: MacOS 10.15+
  • Processor: Apple Silicon or Intel (x86_64 or ARM CPU)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics with full Vulkan 1.2 support or Metal 3 support
  • Storage: 200 MB available space

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11
  • Processor: x86, x64 architecture
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics with full Vulkan 1.0 support or Direct3D 12 support
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11
  • Processor: x86, x64 architecture
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated graphics with full Vulkan 1.2 support or Direct3D 12 support
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
